questions.q: What does a Dev Container define?
o: The development environment: tools, extensions and settings, in a container
The production image that is deployed to the cluster
The database schema and its migration scripts
The CI pipeline stages and their triggers
questions.w: A dev container holds the toolchain and editor setup, described by devcontainer.json in the repository. The application image is a separate concern.

questions.q: Which file configures a dev container?
o: .devcontainer/devcontainer.json
docker-compose.override.yaml in the repository root
pom.xml with a devcontainer profile
A Dockerfile named dev.Dockerfile in the home directory
questions.w: The spec reads .devcontainer/devcontainer.json (or .devcontainer.json). It can reference a Dockerfile or Compose file.

questions.q: What is a Dev Container Feature?
o: A reusable, versioned installer that adds a tool such as Java to any base image
A paid tier of the Dev Containers extension
A flag that enables experimental editor behaviour
A Compose service that starts alongside the container
questions.w: Features are OCI artifacts such as ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/java:1, with options, installed on top of the image.

questions.q: Which lifecycle command runs on the host machine, before the container is created?
o: initializeCommand
onCreateCommand
postCreateCommand
postAttachCommand
questions.w: initializeCommand runs on the host. The others run inside the container: onCreate, updateContent, postCreate, then postStart on each start and postAttach on each attach.

questions.q: How do you give a dev container a PostgreSQL database?
o: Use dockerComposeFile and service, with db as another Compose service
Install PostgreSQL on the host and use localhost
Set the image property to postgres:16
Add a forwardPorts entry of 5432 only
questions.w: The dev container is one Compose service and the database another on the same network, reachable as db:5432.

questions.q: Why can a bind-mounted workspace be slow on macOS and Windows?
o: Docker runs in a VM, so file access crosses a file-sharing layer
The container runs as root, which disables caching
Dev containers cannot read files larger than one megabyte
Git refuses to operate on mounted folders
questions.w: Use a container volume (Clone Repository in Container Volume) and named volumes for Maven or Gradle caches.

questions.q: What is the security downside of docker-outside-of-docker?
o: It mounts the host Docker socket, giving the container control of the host's Docker
It disables all network access inside the container
It forces the container to run an outdated Docker version
It deletes local images each time the editor closes
questions.w: Access to the host socket is effectively root on the host. Docker-in-Docker is isolated but needs privileged mode.

questions.q: What is the main benefit of a dev container prebuild?
o: The image is built once in CI, so opening the project takes seconds
The container runs without Docker installed
Source code is encrypted inside the image
All developers share one running container
questions.w: Prebuilds run Feature installs and dependency downloads ahead of time and publish the image to a registry.
